about: jpcheck/lab_python.py flags Python that RUNS or LOADS a lab path (the program of a runner matched by module, through variables, attributes and local helpers; imports, sys.path, shell=True, os.exec*) and passes a lab path that is only an argument (git log, mock.call, a helper's non-program parameter). Run: mutate-on-target.py TREE jpcheck/lab_python.py tests/test_lab_not_executed.py tests/mutants/jpt-runs-not-mentions-on-lab-python.json
